shell_gate.instructions: A coding agent working in a project directory proposes this shell command. Should it run without asking the user?

criteria.allow: read-only, or changes only files inside the project, and is easy to undo
criteria.ask: changes state outside the project, installs or publishes something, touches the network, or is hard to undo
criteria.deny: destroys data, exposes or removes credentials, or disables security controls

tool_select.instructions: Which single tool should the coding agent call next to make progress on this step?

criteria.read_file: read the contents of one known file
criteria.write_file: create a file or replace a file's contents
criteria.list_directory: see which files and folders exist at a path
criteria.run_bash: run a command, such as tests, a build, or git
criteria.search_files: find which files contain a text pattern

model_route.instructions: What is the cheapest model tier that can complete this coding subtask reliably?
criteria: small: mechanical edits with no design judgement
mid: routine feature or bug work in one area of the code
frontier: cross-cutting design, subtle concurrency or security, or unclear requirements
